body.name: Normalization-preserving rational contrast brackets
body.construction: Within the fixed sign chamber of \(c\), choose \(c'\in\mathcal C_K\cap\mathbb Q^K\) with the same active support and signs, positive coefficients summing to \(1\), negative coefficients summing to \(-1\), and error measured by \(\omega(c,c')=\|c-c'\|_1/2\).
